e: Can I sleep five more minutes?
캔 아이 슬립 파이브 모어 미니츠
d: Then wash your face. It will help you wake up.
Almost. Put on your uniform first.
I'll be quick. Don't start without me!
빨리 할게요. 저 빼고 먹지 마세요!

e: Did you sleep well last night?
d: No, we'll be late. Up you get!
Pancakes. They're getting cold, so hurry.
Can I wear my blue sweater today?
Sure. It's in the drawer. And please make your bed.
그럼. 서랍에 있어. 그리고 이불 정리하렴.

k: Let me check and let you know.
렛 미 체크 앤 렛 유 노우
d: Good morning, Jisu! How was your weekend?
좋은 아침이에요, 지수 씨! 주말 어땠어요?
It was nice, thanks. I just relaxed at home. How about you?
좋았어요, 고마워요. 그냥 집에서 쉬었어요. 당신은요?
I went hiking with my family on Saturday.
That sounds fun! Where did you go?
We went to Bukhansan. The weather was perfect.
I've always wanted to go there. Is it hard to climb?
저도 늘 가 보고 싶었어요. 오르기 힘든가요?
Not really. Just bring comfortable shoes and some water.
그렇진 않아요. 편한 신발이랑 물만 챙기세요.
Good to know. Maybe we can go together sometime.
알아 둘게요. 언제 같이 가도 좋겠어요.
I'd love to! How about next month?
Let me check my schedule and let you know.
Sure, no rush. Oh, did you see the email about today's meeting?
그럼요, 천천히 해요. 아, 오늘 회의 메일 봤어요?
Yes, it starts at ten thirty. I'm still working on my slides.
네, 10시 30분에 시작해요. 아직 슬라이드 작업 중이에요.
Do you want a cup of coffee before the meeting?
회의 전에 커피 한 잔 할래요?
Yes, please. I really need one!

e: Can I have some more milk?
캔 아이 해브 섬 모어 밀크
d: They're not bad. Can I have some juice?
Yes, but finish your eggs first.
Done! Now I'm ready for school.
다 먹었어요! 이제 학교 갈 준비 끝.

e: Don't talk with your mouth full.
입에 음식 있을 때 말하지 마.
돈트 토크 위드 유어 마우쓰 풀
d: Good. Put your plate in the sink, please.
Okay. Can I have a snack later?
If you're still hungry after school.
Deal. I'll take my water bottle too.

k: Can I have a medium latte?
캔 아이 해브 어 미디엄 라테
d: Hi! What can I get for you today?
Hi. Can I have a medium latte, please?
안녕하세요. 라테 미디엄 한 잔 주세요.
Iced, please. And can I add an extra shot?
Of course. Would you like anything to eat?
Our blueberry muffins are really popular.
Great, I'll take one of those.
To go, please. I'm in a bit of a hurry.
That'll be seven fifty. Cash or card?
Card, please. Can I get a receipt too?
Here you go. Your order will be ready in a few minutes.
여기 있습니다. 몇 분 뒤에 준비될 거예요.
Thank you. Have a nice day!

e: Can you help me with the zipper?
캔 유 헬프 미 위드 더 지퍼
d: It's in the closet by the door.
Found it! Is my scarf there too?
Yes, and take your gloves. The wind is strong.

e: Put your shoes on the right feet.
풋 유어 슈즈 온 더 라이트 핏
Don't forget your hat and gloves.
돈트 포겟 유어 햇 앤 글러브즈
d: Which one? The thick one or the thin one?
어느 거요? 두꺼운 거요, 얇은 거요?
The thick one. It might snow later.
두꺼운 거. 이따 눈이 올지도 몰라.
Can I wear my boots then?
Good idea. Tie the laces tightly.
Excuse me, could you help me? I'm a little lost.
Sure. Where are you trying to go?
I'm looking for the City Library.
Oh, it's not far from here. Go straight for two blocks.
아, 여기서 멀지 않아요. 두 블록 직진하세요.
Turn left at the bank. You'll see a big park.
은행에서 왼쪽으로 도세요. 큰 공원이 보일 거예요.
Is the library next to the park?
Yes, it's right across from the park entrance.
How long does it take to walk?
About ten minutes. It's an easy walk.
Great. Is there a subway station nearby, just in case?
좋아요. 혹시 모르니 근처에 지하철역도 있나요?
Yes, Central Station is two minutes from the library.
That's very helpful. Thank you so much!

e: I'm going to be late for school.
아임 고잉 투 비 레이트 포 스쿨
Look both ways before you cross.
룩 보스 웨이즈 비포 유 크로스
d: Yes, I have my bag and lunch.
Good. Text me when you get to school.
I will. The crosswalk light is red now.
Wait until it turns green. Be careful!

e: Do you have your lunch box?
두 유 해브 유어 런치 박스
I'll pick you up at three.
아일 픽 유 업 앳 쓰리
d: I will. See you at three!
I'll be at the gate. Walk with your friends.
I always do. Minsu waits at the corner.
Perfect. Call me if anything happens.
Good afternoon, Sunrise Company. How can I help you?
Hello. May I speak to Mr. Kim, please?
안녕하세요. 김 선생님과 통화할 수 있을까요?
I'm sorry, he's in a meeting right now.
Oh, I see. When will he be back?
He should be free after three. Can I take a message?
3시 이후에는 시간이 되실 거예요. 메시지를 남기시겠어요?
Yes, please. This is Anna from Green Design.
Could you spell your last name for me?
Thank you. And what's your phone number?
Let me repeat that to make sure. 010-1234-5678.
That's correct. Please ask him to call me back today.
맞아요. 오늘 중으로 저에게 전화해 달라고 전해 주세요.
I'll give him your message as soon as he's out.
Thanks a lot. Have a great day!

e: It looks like it's going to rain.
잇 룩스 라이크 잇츠 고잉 투 레인
d: It's already raining. Take the big one.
벌써 비 와. 큰 걸로 가져가.
Where is it? I can't find it.
Look behind the door. It's blue.
Got it! Thanks. I'll bring it back.

e: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
잇츠 어 뷰티풀 데이 이즌트 잇
The air quality is bad today.
디 에어 퀄리티 이즈 배드 투데이
d: Is it going to snow today?
Maybe. Dress warmly just in case.
Okay. Should I wear my padded jacket?
Definitely. Your hands get cold fast.
Good morning. What brings you in today?
I've had a sore throat for three days.
Do you have a fever or a cough?
I have a slight fever, and I cough at night.
Let me take a look. Please open your mouth.
Yes, it's a little swollen. It looks like a cold.
I'll prescribe something for you. Take it after meals.
How many times a day should I take it?
Three times a day for five days.
Is there anything I should avoid?
Avoid cold drinks and get plenty of rest.
Thank you, doctor. I'll do that.
It's just a test. You studied hard.
But what if I forget the answers?
Take a deep breath. You'll remember.
Okay. I'll try to stay calm.

e: I'm here if you want to talk.
아임 히어 이프 유 원트 투 토크
Let's take a deep breath together.
렛츠 테이크 어 딥 브레스 투게더
d: Tell me about it. I'm listening.
My friend didn't invite me to her party.
친구가 자기 파티에 나를 초대 안 했어요.
That must hurt. I'm sorry that happened.
You still are. Maybe it was a mistake. Want to talk to her tomorrow?
여전히 친해. 실수였을 수도 있어. 내일 얘기해 볼래?

k: We need a few more minutes.
위 니드 어 퓨 모어 미니츠
d: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?
Yes, under the name Park. A table for two at seven.
Right this way, please. Here are your menus.
Thank you. Could we have some water to start?
Of course. Are you ready to order, or do you need a few minutes?
물론이죠. 주문하시겠어요, 아니면 시간이 좀 필요하세요?
We need a few more minutes, please.
I'll have the grilled salmon. What comes with it?
저는 연어구이로 할게요. 같이 나오는 게 뭐예요?
It comes with rice and a side salad.
Perfect. And I'll have the mushroom pasta.
Would you like anything to drink?
Two glasses of sparkling water, please.
Excuse me, could we get the check, please?
Certainly. Everything was delicious, thank you.
May I go to the restroom?

e: Could you say that again, please?
d: Do you want to be my partner?
Sure. Let's start with question one.
Okay. I'll read and you write.
Great. We'll finish before the bell.

e: What did you learn at school?
Did you hand in your assignment?
Let me know if you need help.
렛 미 노우 이프 유 니드 헬프
d: That sounds fun. Tell me more.
We saw how bees make honey.
Really? What else did you learn?
Each bee has a job, like a team.

k: Do you have this in a larger size?
두 유 해브 디스 인 어 라저 사이즈
d: Hi, can I help you find something?
Yes, I'm looking for a light jacket.
How about this one? It's very popular this season.
이건 어떠세요? 이번 시즌에 인기가 많아요.
I like the color. Can I try it on?
색이 마음에 들어요. 입어 봐도 될까요?
Of course. The fitting room is right over there.
It's a little tight in the shoulders.
Let me get you a large.
This one fits much better. How much is it?
It's eighty dollars, but it's twenty percent off today.
That's a good deal. I'll take it.
Yes, please. Thank you for your help.

e: I have a lot of homework today.
아이 해브 어 랏 오브 홈워크 투데이
d: I got it! The answer is twelve.

e: Turn off the TV and focus.
턴 오프 더 티비 앤 포커스
d: Okay. This word problem confuses me.
Like this? Then I add them?

k: Could you turn on the air conditioner?
쿠쥬 턴 온 디 에어 컨디셔너
d: Hi. Could you take me to the airport, please?
Terminal 2. I have a flight at six.
No problem. Traffic is light this morning.
문제없어요. 오늘 아침은 차가 별로 없어요.
About forty minutes. We'll be there in plenty of time.
Great. Could you turn on the air conditioner a little?
Here you go. Please keep the change.

e: Do you want to share my snack?
두 유 원트 투 셰어 마이 스낵
d: Same here! What do you drink with it?
Sure! I'll trade my cookie for your jelly.
좋아! 내 쿠키랑 네 젤리 바꾸자.

e: What did you have for lunch?
d: Did you eat all your vegetables?
Most of them. I left the mushrooms.

k: Could I get a room with a view?
전망 좋은 방으로 받을 수 있을까요?
쿠드 아이 겟 어 룸 위드 어 뷰
d: Good evening. Welcome to Ocean View Hotel.
안녕하세요. 오션뷰 호텔에 오신 걸 환영합니다.
Hello. I have a reservation under Lee.
May I see your passport, please?
Thank you. You booked a double room for three nights.
Yes, it's served from seven to ten in the restaurant.
Could I get a room with a sea view?
바다가 보이는 방으로 받을 수 있을까요?
Let me check. Yes, we have one on the eighth floor.
That would be wonderful. What time is check-out?
Check-out is at eleven. Here are your key cards.
Yes, the password is on the key card holder.
네, 비밀번호는 카드키 케이스에 적혀 있어요.
Thank you very much. I'll go up now.

e: Do you want to play with us?
두 유 원트 투 플레이 위드 어스
I'm sorry. It was my mistake.
아임 쏘리 잇 워즈 마이 미스테이크
We have a lot in common.
위 해브 어 랏 인 커먼
d: Want to come to my house?
I'll bring my cards. Do you like card games?
Yes! Let's make teams of two.
Deal. This is going to be fun.

e: Who did you play with today?
Would you like to invite a friend over?
우쥬 라이크 투 인바이트 어 프렌드 오버
d: Can Minsu come over on Saturday?
Thanks! Can we play in my room?
Yes, but keep the door open and the noise down.
그래, 하지만 문은 열어 두고 조용히 해.

k: Do you have any bags to check in?
두 유 해브 애니 백스 투 체크 인
d: Good morning. May I see your passport and ticket?
Here you go. I'm flying to Tokyo.
Do you have any bags to check in?
Please place it on the scale. It's twenty kilos.
Is that okay? I think the limit is twenty-three.
Yes, you're fine. Would you like a window or an aisle seat?
네, 괜찮습니다. 창가 자리와 복도 자리 중 어느 쪽을 원하세요?
Here is your boarding pass. Your gate is B12.
Boarding starts at nine fifteen, so please be there by nine.
Go straight and follow the signs.
Really? I look like my dad.
Everyone says you have his smile.
And you laugh just like Mom.
그리고 너는 웃는 게 엄마랑 똑같아.
I'm lucky to have a great family.

e: We're so lucky to have each other.
위아 소 러키 투 해브 이치 아더
d: Can I tell him about my test?
Yes, he'll be proud of your score.
I can't wait to visit them this summer.
Me neither. We'll bring his favorite snacks.

k: What do you like to do in your free time?
왓 두 유 라이크 투 두 인 유어 프리 타임
It was nice talking to you.
잇 워즈 나이스 토킹 투 유
d: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Daniel.
안녕하세요, 처음 뵙는 것 같아요. 저는 대니얼이에요.
Nice to meet you, Daniel. I'm Sora.
Nice to meet you too. What do you do, Sora?
저도 반가워요. 소라 씨는 무슨 일을 하세요?
I work in marketing at a small company. How about you?
작은 회사에서 마케팅 일을 해요. 당신은요?
I'm an engineer. I've been here for two years.
Yes, I live about ten minutes away.
I'm from Busan, but I moved to Seoul for work.
부산 출신인데 일 때문에 서울로 왔어요.
What do you like to do in your free time?
I enjoy cooking and going to the movies.
요리하는 것과 영화 보는 걸 좋아해요.
That's great. I love movies too.
We should go to one together sometime.
I'd like that. It was really nice talking to you.

e: My hobby is playing the piano.
마이 하비 이즈 플레잉 더 피아노
I'm really into soccer these days.
아임 리얼리 인투 사커 디즈 데이즈
d: That's a long time! Do you practice daily?
Can you play a song for me?

e: What are you into these days?
왓 아 유 인투 디즈 데이즈
Find time for what you love.
파인드 타임 포 왓 유 러브
d: Can I get a new book?
Can I pick a comic book?
Pick one with a good story.
Can we go to the bookstore on Saturday?
Okay. We can read at the café too.

k: What do you have in mind?
왓 두 유 해브 인 마인드
d: Hey, are you free this weekend?
I think so. What do you have in mind?
아마도요. 뭐 생각해 둔 거 있어요?
There's a new Italian restaurant downtown. Want to try it?
시내에 새 이탈리안 식당이 생겼어요. 가 볼래요?
That sounds great. Saturday or Sunday?
Saturday works better for me. How about lunch?
저는 토요일이 더 좋아요. 점심 어때요?
How about in front of the subway station?
Yes. I'll book a table just in case.
네. 혹시 모르니 자리를 예약해 둘게요.
Thanks. Text me if anything changes.
고마워요. 바뀌는 게 있으면 문자 줘요.
Will do. I'm looking forward to it.
Me too. See you on Saturday!
Keep it up. Who scored the last goal?
계속 이렇게 해. 마지막 골은 누가 넣었어?
Minho did. It was a long kick.
Wow! Let's play again next week.

e: Exercise is good for your health.
엑서사이즈 이즈 굿 포 유어 헬스
d: Along the river. It's flat and safe.
Great. Can I bring water and snacks?
Good morning! Can you believe this weather?
I know. It was so sunny yesterday.
And now it's raining like crazy.
Luckily, yes. I checked the forecast last night.
I didn't, so I got soaked on my way here.
저는 안 봐서 오는 길에 흠뻑 젖었어요.
Oh no. Do you have a towel at your desk?
I have a small one. It'll do.
작은 거 하나 있어요. 그거면 돼요.
Is it going to rain all day?
The forecast says it'll stop by this afternoon.
That's good. I'm planning to walk to lunch.
The temperature is dropping too. Wear a jacket.
Thanks for the tip. Well, this is my floor.
알려 줘서 고마워요. 아, 저는 여기서 내려요.
Have a great day! Stay dry!
좋은 하루 보내요! 젖지 않게 조심하고요!

e: Do you have this in a bigger size?
두 유 해브 디스 인 어 비거 사이즈
d: Sure. The fitting room is over there.
A little tight around the shoulders.
Let's try the next size up.
한 사이즈 큰 걸로 해 보자.
This one fits perfectly. I'll take it.

e: Can I get a receipt, please?
캔 아이 겟 어 리시트 플리즈
d: Where can I find the milk?
Thank you. And where are the eggs?
They're next to the milk, on your left.
Got it. Do you sell fresh bread here?
Yes, the bakery is at the back.

k: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
두 유 해브 애니 브라더스 오어 시스터스
Do you live close to them?
두 유 리브 클로즈 투 뎀
We get together for the holidays.
위 겟 투게더 포 더 할러데이즈
그 아이는 막 일곱 살이 됐어요.
d: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
Yes, I have one older sister and one younger brother.
네, 언니 한 명과 남동생 한 명이 있어요.
That's nice. Do you live close to them?
My sister lives in Daegu, and my brother is in the army.
언니는 대구에 살고, 동생은 군대에 있어요.
Do you get to see them often?
Not really, maybe three or four times a year.
그렇진 않아요, 일 년에 서너 번쯤이요.
We usually get together for the holidays.
What about your parents? Are they still working?
My father retired last year, and my mother teaches piano.
아버지는 작년에 은퇴하셨고, 어머니는 피아노를 가르치세요.
That's wonderful. Do you play the piano too?
A little. My mother taught me when I was young.
Yes, a daughter. She just turned seven.
네, 딸이 하나 있어요. 이제 막 일곱 살이 됐어요.
Seven is a fun age. You must be very busy.
일곱 살이면 재밌는 나이죠. 많이 바쁘시겠어요.

w: Put it in the piggy bank.
풋 잇 인 더 피기 뱅크

e: I'm saving money for a toy.
아임 세이빙 머니 포 어 토이
How much do I have left?
하우 머치 두 아이 해브 레프트
d: Only if you have enough money.
I have ten thousand won saved.
Then you can buy one small snack.
그럼 작은 간식 하나는 사도 돼.
Good idea. Save for the soccer ball.

e: Do you need it or want it?
두 유 니드 잇 오어 원트 잇
d: Let's think about it for a week.
That robot costs a lot, doesn't it?
Yes. Do you still want it next week?
I think so. Can I save my allowance?
그럴 것 같아요. 용돈을 모아도 돼요?
Good idea. I'll add a little if you save half.
좋은 생각이야. 반을 모으면 조금 보태 줄게.

k: What do you do on weekends?
왓 두 유 두 온 위켄즈
How long have you been doing that?
하우 롱 해브 유 빈 두잉 댓
It's a great way to stay in shape.
잇츠 어 그레이트 웨이 투 스테이 인 셰이프
I'd love to give it a try.
아이드 러브 투 기브 잇 어 트라이
d: What do you usually do on weekends?
I like to go cycling along the river.
Really? How long have you been doing that?
About three years. I started after I bought a bike.
Do you go alone or with friends?
Usually with a cycling club. We meet every Sunday morning.
보통 자전거 동호회랑요. 매주 일요일 아침에 만나요.
That sounds like a great way to stay in shape.
It is. And it's a good way to meet people.
Not at all. We have different groups for different levels.
I haven't ridden a bike in years.
저는 몇 년째 자전거를 안 탔어요.
You can borrow one of mine to try.
제 자전거 중 하나를 빌려서 타 봐도 돼요.
That's very kind. I'd love to give it a try.
정말 친절하시네요. 한번 해 보고 싶어요.
Great! Let's go together this Sunday.

e: I think I have a fever.
아이 씽크 아이 해브 어 피버
I need to see a doctor.
아이 니드 투 씨 어 닥터
d: It's a little bitter, but it helps.
Can I drink water after it?
Yes, drink lots of warm water.
Okay. I want to feel better soon.

e: I hope you feel better soon.
아이 호프 유 필 베터 순
d: Do I have to go to school?
No. Stay home and rest today.
Can I watch TV in bed?
Only a little. You need to sleep.
Can you bring me some water?
Sure. And I'll make warm soup.

k: It's the least I can do.
잇츠 더 리스트 아이 캔 두
d: Hi, I'm so sorry I'm late.
It's okay. I just got here myself.
No, really, I should have called you.
아니에요, 정말 제가 전화를 드렸어야 했는데.
My train stopped for twenty minutes because of a signal problem.
신호 문제 때문에 지하철이 20분 동안 멈췄어요.
Oh, that's terrible. Were you stuck inside?
아, 정말 힘들었겠어요. 안에 갇혀 있었어요?
Yes, and my phone battery was dead, too.
Don't worry about it. It's not your fault.
Let me buy you a coffee to make up for it.
만회하는 의미로 커피 한 잔 살게요.
You don't have to do that.
I insist. It's the least I can do.
제가 사고 싶어요. 이 정도는 해야죠.
Alright, thank you. A latte would be great.
Coming right up. And again, I'm sorry.
바로 사 올게요. 그리고 다시 한번 죄송해요.

w: I sleep with my teddy bear.
아이 슬립 위드 마이 테디 베어
e: I'll brush my teeth and wash up.
아일 브러시 마이 티쓰 앤 워시 업
Can you turn off the light?
캔 유 턴 오프 더 라이트
d: Good. Did you pack your bag for tomorrow?
Yes. Everything is on my desk.
Then brush your teeth and go to bed.
Okay. Good night. See you in the morning.

e: I love you to the moon and back.
아이 러브 유 투 더 문 앤 백
d: Can you read one more book?
책 한 권 더 읽어 줄래요?
딱 한 권만. 그리고 자야 해.
Okay. Can I pick the dinosaur book?
Will you stay until I fall asleep?
For five minutes. Close your eyes.

k: Could you show me how to…?
d: Excuse me, do you have a minute?
The printer isn't working again. Do you know what's wrong?
프린터가 또 안 돼요. 뭐가 문제인지 알아요?
Let me take a look. Is there any paper in it?
Yes, I just filled it. The screen says 'paper jam'.
네, 방금 채웠어요. 화면에 '용지 걸림'이라고 떠요.
Oh, that's easy. Open this cover and pull the paper out.
아, 쉬워요. 이 덮개를 열고 종이를 빼내세요.
Yes, gently. Now close the cover.
It's working now. Thank you so much!
Actually, could I ask you one more thing?
Could you show me how to scan documents?
Sure, follow me. It only takes a minute.

e: Let me take out the trash.
렛 미 테이크 아웃 더 트래쉬
d: Don't forget to put your clothes away.
I won't. Should I wipe the desk too?
Yes, please. Use the wet cloth.
Done! My room is clean now.
다 했어요! 이제 내 방이 깨끗해요.

e: Thanks for helping. That's a big help.
땡스 포 헬핑 댓츠 어 빅 헬프
d: Perfect. Plants need water, but not too much.
좋아. 식물은 물이 필요하지만 너무 많으면 안 돼.
Thank you. That's a big help.

k: How long have you felt this way?
하우 롱 해브 유 펠트 디스 웨이
How often should I take it?
하우 오픈 슈드 아이 테이크 잇
d: Hi. How can I help you?
I have a headache, and I can't sleep well.
머리가 아프고 잠도 잘 못 자요.
How long have you felt this way?
About two days. Maybe it's because of stress.
Are you taking any other medicine right now?
Then I'd recommend this pain reliever.
How often should I take it?
One tablet every six hours, with water.
Is it safe to take on an empty stomach?
It's better to eat something first.
먼저 뭐라도 먹고 드시는 게 좋아요.
If it doesn't get better in three days, see a doctor.
3일 지나도 나아지지 않으면 병원에 가 보세요.

e: I want to take care of a pet.
아이 원트 투 테이크 케어 오브 어 펫
Elephants are the biggest land animals.
엘리펀츠 아 더 비기스트 랜드 애니멀즈
d: Only if you walk it every day.
Of course I will. I'll take him out before school.
He also needs fresh water and food.
I'll feed him morning and evening.
Then let's visit the shelter this weekend.
그럼 이번 주말에 보호소에 가 보자.
Yes, but be gentle with him.
I'll pet him softly. What should we name him?
Let's ask everyone to suggest one.
I like 'Cookie'. He's brown like a cookie.
Cookie it is. Welcome home, Cookie!
쿠키로 하자. 집에 온 걸 환영해, 쿠키!

k: I'd like to open an account.
아이드 라이크 투 오픈 언 어카운트
d: Good afternoon. How can I help you today?
I'd like to open a savings account.
Certainly. May I see your ID, please?
Thank you. Please fill out this form.
Do I need to write my address here?
Yes, and your phone number as well.
All done. What's the interest rate?
That sounds good. Can I also send money abroad?
좋네요. 해외 송금도 할 수 있나요?
Yes, but there's a small transfer fee.
네, 하지만 소정의 송금 수수료가 있어요.
How long does it take for the money to arrive?
Usually one to two business days.
I see. Thank you for explaining everything.

e: I'm having a party this Saturday.
아임 해빙 어 파티 디스 새터데이
d: Will you come to my party?
Just yourself. We'll have cake and games.
Then I'll bring a small present.
Thanks! I can't wait to see you there.

e: Congratulations, I'm so proud of you.
컨그래츄레이션스 아임 소 프라우드 오브 유
Many happy returns of the day!
메니 해피 리턴즈 오브 더 데이
d: Let's make it five this time.
Okay. I'll choose my closest five.
알겠어요. 제일 친한 다섯 명을 고를게요.
Good. We'll use the living room.
Can we have a pizza party?
Yes. I'll order after you send the invitations.
Hi, I bought this sweater last week, but it doesn't fit.
안녕하세요, 지난주에 이 스웨터를 샀는데 맞지 않아요.
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt?
Thank you. Would you like a refund or an exchange?
Can I exchange it for a smaller size?
더 작은 사이즈로 교환할 수 있나요?
Let me check if we have one in stock.
I'm afraid we're out of small in that color.
We have it in gray and navy.
I'll take the navy one, then.
Great. There's no price difference, so you don't owe anything.
좋아요. 가격 차이가 없어서 추가 금액은 없어요.
Wonderful. Thank you for being so helpful.
My pleasure. Have a great day!

e: Excuse me, where is the library?
익스큐즈 미 웨어 이즈 더 라이브러리
d: Good. Which way do I go?
Go straight and turn left at the bank.
Is it on the left or right side?
On the right, next to the bakery.

e: Could you tell me how to get to the station?
쿠쥬 텔 미 하우 투 겟 투 더 스테이션
Follow me. I know the way.
팔로우 미 아이 노우 더 웨이
d: Thank you. How do I get there?
Go straight two blocks and turn right.

k: Is there a grocery store nearby?
이즈 데어 어 그로서리 스토어 니어바이
Let me know if you need anything.
렛 미 노우 이프 유 니드 애니씽
d: Hi there! Are you the new neighbor?
Yes, I just moved in yesterday. I'm Hana.
네, 어제 막 이사 왔어요. 저는 하나예요.
Welcome to the building! I'm Tom, I live next door.
건물에 오신 걸 환영해요! 저는 톰이고 옆집에 살아요.
Nice to meet you, Tom. It's a quiet place, isn't it?
Very quiet. Most people here are friendly.
아주 조용해요. 여기 사람들은 대부분 친절해요.
That's good to hear. Is there a grocery store nearby?
Yes, there's one two blocks away. It's open until eleven.
네, 두 블록 떨어진 곳에 있어요. 11시까지 열어요.
Great. And what day is the trash collected?
Tuesdays and Fridays. You put it out in the evening.
Thanks. I'm still learning how things work here.
고마워요. 아직 여기 방식을 배우는 중이에요.
Don't worry. Just let me know if you need anything.
걱정 마세요. 필요한 게 있으면 말해요.
That's very kind. I might knock on your door.
Anytime! Would you like to have coffee this weekend?
언제든지요! 이번 주말에 커피 한잔 할래요?
I'd love to. See you then!
How do you go to school?

e: It takes thirty minutes by subway.
잇 테익스 써티 미니츠 바이 서브웨이
d: It's too far to walk. Good idea.
Let's wait here. The taxi stand is close.
Then we'll get there before the movie.

e: We'll be there in ten minutes.
위일 비 데어 인 텐 미니츠
d: About ten more. Look, you can see the sea.
Wow! Can we stop and take a photo?
Yes, at the next rest area.

k: What time would work for you?
왓 타임 우드 워크 포 유
d: Hi Mark, do you have a moment to talk about tomorrow's meeting?
마크, 내일 회의에 대해 잠깐 얘기할 수 있어요?
I have a conflict at ten. Could we reschedule?
10시에 겹치는 일정이 있어요. 일정을 바꿀 수 있을까요?
I see. What time would work for you?
Anytime after one o'clock would be fine.
Let me check the others' calendars.
Thank you. I'm sorry for the inconvenience.
No problem. How about two o'clock?
Two o'clock works for me. How long will the meeting take?
About an hour. We need to review the budget.
한 시간쯤요. 예산 검토를 해야 해서요.
Got it. Should I prepare anything beforehand?
Just bring the latest sales report.
Will do. I'll send a new invitation to everyone.

e: I'd like a cheeseburger and a juice.
아이드 라이크 어 치즈버거 앤 어 주스
Can I get some water, please?
캔 아이 겟 섬 워터 플리즈
d: Would you like anything to drink?
A glass of orange juice, please.
Would you like a dessert after that?

e: Could we have the menu, please?
쿠드 위 해브 더 메뉴 플리즈
Can we get a box to go?
남은 음식 포장해 주실 수 있나요?
캔 위 겟 어 박스 투 고
Could we get the check, please?
쿠드 위 겟 더 체크 플리즈
d: How would you like it cooked?
Medium, please. And a side salad.
Just water for me. Thank you.
Do you have a minute? I'm worried about the deadline.
Of course. Which project are you talking about?
The client report due on Friday.
I'm about seventy percent done, but the data is taking longer than expected.
70퍼센트쯤 했는데 데이터 작업이 예상보다 오래 걸려요.
I see. What do you need to finish it on time?
Maybe some help with the charts.
차트 작업을 도와줄 사람이 있으면 좋겠어요.
I can ask Emily to help you tomorrow morning.
내일 아침에 에밀리에게 도와 달라고 부탁해 볼게요.
That would be a big help. Thank you.
정말 큰 도움이 될 거예요. 고마워요.
Also, should we let the client know about a possible delay?
그리고 지연 가능성을 고객에게 알려야 할까요?
Let's wait. I think we can make it.
기다려 봐요. 우리가 해낼 수 있을 것 같아요.
Okay. I'll update you by tomorrow afternoon.
알겠어요. 내일 오후까지 상황을 알려 드릴게요.
Sounds good. Don't stress too much.

e: Can I use your phone for a minute?
캔 아이 유즈 유어 폰 포 어 미닛
d: Put your phone away at dinner.
Okay. Just let me finish this.
It can wait. Dinner is more important.
그건 기다려도 돼. 저녁이 더 중요해.
Okay. I'll finish after we eat.
Thank you. Tell me about your day.
We had a science experiment today!
No. A deal is a deal.
It's a short one. Please, Mom!
We agreed on two videos only.
You're right. I'll turn it off.
Thank you. Let's play a board game instead.

k: What are you in the mood for?
왓 아 유 인 더 무드 포
d: It's almost noon. Are you hungry?
Starving. Where should we go for lunch?
I'm okay with anything. What are you in the mood for?
저는 아무거나 괜찮아요. 뭐 먹고 싶어요?
I had Korean food yesterday, so maybe something different.
어제 한식을 먹어서 오늘은 다른 게 좋을 것 같아요.
How about Japanese? There's a good ramen place nearby.
일식은 어때요? 근처에 맛있는 라멘집이 있어요.
Ramen sounds great, but it's usually crowded.
라멘 좋죠, 그런데 보통 사람이 많아요.
We can go early. Let's leave right now.
일찍 가면 돼요. 지금 바로 나가요.
Okay. Do you want to invite anyone else?
Sure. Let's ask Jenny and Min.
Is it my turn to pay?
No, I paid last time. It's your turn next week.
아니에요, 지난번에 제가 샀어요. 다음 주가 당신 차례예요.
Fair enough. Let's split the bill this time.
Great. Let's grab our jackets and go.
Great. Do I have time to get a snack?
Hurry. We must leave at four.

e: There's no rush. Take your time.
데어즈 노 러시 테이크 유어 타임
Time flies when you're having fun.
타임 플라이즈 웬 유어 해빙 펀
d: How much time do I have?
Is that enough to finish my project?
Probably not. Let's make a plan.
아마 부족할 거야. 계획을 세워 보자.
Good. Set a timer for each step.

k: I couldn't have done it without you.
아이 쿠든트 해브 던 잇 위다웃 유
It means a lot to me.
잇 민즈 어 랏 투 미
d: Thank you for helping me yesterday. I couldn't have finished without you.
어제 도와줘서 고마워요. 당신 없이는 끝내지 못했을 거예요.
You're welcome. I was happy to help.
Your presentation was excellent, by the way.
Thank you. I was really nervous.
It didn't show. You spoke clearly and confidently.
티가 안 났어요. 또박또박 자신 있게 말하던데요.
I practiced a lot at home.
It paid off. The manager was impressed.
You deserve it. You work so hard.
그럴 자격 있어요. 정말 열심히 하잖아요.
I appreciate that. It means a lot to me.
그렇게 말해 줘서 고마워요. 제겐 큰 의미예요.
Let me treat you to lunch as a thank-you.
Thursday works. I'm looking forward to it.

e: I want to watch a movie.
아이 원트 투 워치 어 무비
d: What do you want to do?
I want to ride a bike.

e: What are you going to do this weekend?
왓 아 유 고잉 투 두 디스 위켄드
I'm going to visit my grandparents.
아임 고잉 투 비짓 마이 그랜페어런츠
d: I'm thinking about going to the beach.
That sounds fun. Can I come?
Awesome! I'll ask my parents tonight.

e: Do we have any plans for Sunday?
두 위 해브 애니 플랜즈 포 선데이
Let's make the most of the weekend.
렛츠 메이크 더 모스트 오브 더 위켄드
d: That sounds great. Let's plan it.
Near the lake. We can cook outside.
호수 근처요. 밖에서 요리할 수 있잖아요.
Okay. Let's check the weather first.
If it's sunny, can we book a site?
Yes. I'll look at the reservations tonight.
그래. 오늘 밤 예약 현황을 볼게.

k: Could you keep your voice down?
I didn't mean to disturb you.
아이 디든트 민 투 디스터브 유
d: Excuse me, sorry to bother you.
It's a bit cold in here. Would you mind if I turned the air conditioner down?
여기 좀 추워요. 에어컨을 조금 낮춰도 될까요?
Oh, of course. I didn't realize.
Thank you. I get cold easily.
Do you want to borrow my cardigan?
That's kind, but I'm fine now.
By the way, could you keep your voice down a little?
I'm trying to concentrate on a report.
I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to disturb you.
It's alright. I really appreciate it.
If you need quiet time, we can use the meeting room.
조용한 시간이 필요하면 회의실을 써도 돼요.
That's a good idea. I'll book it for an hour.
Great. Let me know if I can help.

e: I packed my swimsuit and towel.
아이 팩트 마이 스윔수트 앤 타월
I can't wait for the trip.
아이 캔트 웨이트 포 더 트립
d: Good. Is your ticket in the same place?
Yes. I printed it last night.
Let's go through security. Follow me.
I'd like a room for three nights.
Certainly. May I have your name?
Here you are. Is breakfast included?
Yes, from seven to ten in the lobby.
Thank you. Which floor is our room on?
The fifth floor. The elevator is on your right.

k: Do you remember how to get to my place?
두 유 리멤버 하우 투 겟 투 마이 플레이스
I can't wait to see it.
아이 캔트 웨이트 투 씨 잇
d: Hey, are you busy next Saturday?
I'm having a small housewarming party. Would you like to come?
I'd love to! What time does it start?
Around six o'clock. Dinner will be at seven.
Just yourself. But a dessert would be nice.
몸만 와도 돼요. 디저트가 있으면 좋긴 해요.
No problem. I'll bring a cake.
Do you remember how to get to my place?
I think so. It's near the park, right?
그런 것 같아요. 공원 근처 맞죠?
Yes, the white building on the corner. I'm on the fourth floor.
There's a small lot behind the building.
Perfect. I can't wait to see your new place!
좋아요. 새 집 빨리 보고 싶어요!

e: Excuse me, may I come in?
익스큐즈 미 메이 아이 컴 인
d: Please let me know if you need anything.
I will. Have a nice day!
It's kind of you to say so.
We'll try to keep it down.

k: Have you decided where to go?
해브 유 디사이디드 웨어 투 고
How many days should we stay?
하우 메니 데이즈 슈드 위 스테이
d: Have you decided where to go for our vacation?
I'm thinking about Jeju Island. What do you think?
That sounds lovely. How many days should we stay?
Four days and three nights would be enough.
Let me check the flight prices.
I already looked. It's about one hundred twenty thousand won each way.
That's reasonable. What about the hotel?
I found one near the beach for sixty dollars a night.
Yes, and it has a nice pool.
Yes, it's easier to see the island that way.
Thanks. I'm so excited for this trip!
What did you learn from it?
I should check my work twice.
Thanks. I'll try harder next time.

e: 넌 해낼 수 있는 힘이 있어.
d: Try it anyway. I'm with you.
그래도 해 보자. 내가 옆에 있어.
What if everyone laughs at me?
Then you'll know you were brave to try.
그럼 시도한 용기를 알게 될 거야.
Okay. I'll try. Please watch me.
I'll be right there, cheering for you.

k: Do you offer a trial session?
두 유 오퍼 어 트라이얼 세션
d: Hi, I'm interested in joining the gym.
Welcome! Have you worked out here before?
환영해요! 여기서 운동해 본 적 있으세요?
No, this is my first time.
Let me show you around. This is the cardio area.
안내해 드릴게요. 여기는 유산소 운동 구역이에요.
And where do I find the weights?
Over there, next to the mirrors.
We have monthly, three-month, and yearly plans.
It's fifty thousand won, and it includes the locker.
Do you offer a trial session?
Yes, your first day is free.
That's great. Can I start today?
Of course. Just fill out this form and we'll get you started.
